newsitem.title: USA: Raster Graphics sees expenses 32 - 34 pct.
newsitem.headline: Raster Graphics sees expenses 32 - 34 pct.

text.p: Raster Graphics Inc Thursday said operating expenses will range between 32 and 34 percent of revenue in 1997's third and fourth quarters as it boosts its presence overseas and expands its U.S. sales force.

Earlier, the company reported a second quarter profit of $0.13 a share on revenue of $14.1 million versus $0.09 a share on sales of $10.2 million one year ago. Operating expenses totaled $4.5 million, or about 32 percent of revenue.
In addition, the company said it expects second half 1997 revenue growth to range between 37 and 40 percent and net income growth in the high 40 percent range, year over year.
In addition, the company said it has launched several programs that could boost year over year revenue growth above 40 percent in 1998.

"We are pursuing opportunities to increase our direct presence and expand our distribution channels in key international markets, as well as expand our sales and distribution capabilities in the United States," the company said in a statement.
Raster Graphics makes large-format color printing systems for the color digital printing market.
